submitted.rationale: XRD shows index 2 (Pb0.68Sb0.32) is dominated by the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore (peaks near Q≈2.04, 2.36, 3.33, 3.91). This phase has a band gap near 2.4–2.5 eV, which suits the 2.4 eV illumination. Of the three EQE measurements, index 2 was highest at 0.093%, against 0.046% at index 5 and 0.036% at index 0, so EQE peaks near this composition.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.036%, lower than index 2. It is past the peak on the Pb-rich side, possibly because of excess Pb or a secondary phase.
Measured EQE 0.046%. EQE falls as Sb increases.
XRD shows a mainly different Sb-rich phase (likely PbSb2O6, with a wider gap) and only a little pyrochlore.
XRD matches index 8: the Sb-rich phase dominates, so it is expected to absorb 2.4 eV light poorly.
